craft_notes: Sthāyin: vaunting groundedness. Device: comma→dash (vaunt held, grounding released). Rejected: 'stay' for 'stand' — kept stand. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: 'Blest I, quits I, big am I' — firm may that fancy stand,
grounded his whom thou groundest, Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dhanyo 'smi kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mahān asmīti bhāvanā bhavet sālambanā tasya yas tvadālambanaḥ prabho
